responsibility: Drives the overall Graphite loop-transformation pipeline and defines the Graphite GIMPLE passes. It prepares loop and dominance information, canonicalizes loops into the form expected by SCoP detection and schedule construction, creates the global isl context and scalar-evolution cache, invokes SCoP detection, polyhedral construction, schedule transformation, and GIMPLE regeneration for each selected scop, and then performs SSA/CFG cleanup after successful changes. It also contains the pass gate logic for -fgraphite, -floop-nest-optimize, and parallelization-related options, along with Graphite-specific statistics and optimization diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Implements and runs the Graphite optimization passes themselves: it owns pass gating, loop-form canonicalization, isl context setup, SCoP discovery/iteration, transformation execution, and post-transform SSA/CFG cleanup. In contrast, gcc/graphite.h is the shared interface that defines the Graphite data structures and cross-file APIs those passes use.
